summary: BMA HEISTEKNISK RÅDGIVNING AS (org. no. 974 411 709) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-04-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 74.990 (All annen faglig, vitenskapelig og teknisk virksomhet ikke nevnt annet sted); it has 8 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 15.2 m and net income was NOK 11 004. CEO: Stian Askmann-Olsen; board chair: Øystein Ueland; auditor: HØILUND REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 636700MQ7MWF19Z99940.
